text.11:93: And, O my people! Act according to your power, lo! I (too) am acting. Ye will soon know on whom there cometh a doom that will abase him, and who it is that lieth. And watch! Lo! I am a watcher with you.
text.44:10: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
text.44:59: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
text.54:27: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
